initial_inventory.title: [Spec Decode][DeepSeek-V4.1] Coupled drafts and keyed verification on vocabulary shards

metadata.title: [Spec Decode][DeepSeek-V4.1] Coupled drafts and keyed verification on vocabulary shards
metadata.body:
Contributed by PLI Labs (Proprietary Legal Intelligence). Written with AI assistance (Claude Code).

**Depends on #1370 and #1375.** This branch is #1370 (two commits), then #1375 (one commit), then one commit; review only the last commit, "Coupled drafts and keyed verification on vocabulary shards". It uses #1370's Markov-shard emulation and TP layout and #1375's keyed draws. Stack order: #1370, #1375, this PR. Our MRV2 PR builds on it.

## Purpose

Two opt-in follow-ups to the coupled sampled drafts of #1375 (a port of `Elevatormusic/TensorFold#25`). Both default off, and both are exact: they produce the same keyed samples as the gathered path.

- **`VLLM_V41_COUPLED_SHARD=1`.** The coupled draft step of the DSpark Markov head runs on each TP rank's vocabulary shard inside the drafter's captured query graph (`query_graph.py`, `markov_coupled.coupled_shard_tokens`): every rank scores its own rows with keyed draws at the global token ids, and one slot all-reduce per step picks the winner, instead of gathering the full draft logits. `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_SHARD_CHECK=1` compares it with the gathered path at run time (debug).
- **`VLLM_V41_COUPLED_LOCAL=1`** (with `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_DRAFTS=1`). Keyed verification of the target from the vocabulary shards (`model.local_logits`, `coupled_draw.KeyedShard`) when every row is random and only a temperature applies, without gathering the full target logits. Greedy rows, top-k / top-p / min-p, min-tokens, logprobs, penalties, allowed or bad words, a thinking budget, grammar, PP broadcast and any other logits processing take the gathered path (`coupled_draw.local_fallback`, `_can_use_v41_keyed_local`). `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_LOCAL_CHECK=1` compares both (debug).
- The local-logits path refuses a biased head; the rejection sampler clears the candidate ids that the skipped `forward()` would have cleared.
- `tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_fork4card_pp1.py`: the 4-card TP4/PP1 interaction of the coupled paths with cold-expert verify truncation (`VLLM_V41_TRUNC`).

## Test Plan

```bash
ruff check / ruff format --check   # ruff 0.14.0, changed .py files
python -m tools.generate_env_reference --check
python -m tools.config_inventory --check
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_metadata.py
python tools/pre_commit/check_env_registration.py
python -m tools.generate_architecture_reference --check
# kernels in the Triton interpreter (on before triton is imported), TP ranks emulated as threads:
TRITON_INTERPRET=1 CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_coupled_drafts.py \
  tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_coupled_fused.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_coupled_shard.py \
  tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_coupled_local.py tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_fork4card_pp1.py \
  tests/models/test_deepseek_v41_markov_shard.py
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES= pytest -q tests/v1/sample/test_rejection_sampler.py tests/v1/worker/test_gpu_model_runner.py \
  tests/v1/spec_decode/test_dspark.py tests/v1/spec_decode/test_rejection_sampler_utils.py
```

## Path coverage

| Path / provider | Format | Key conditions (shape, TP/EP, graph, capability) | Expected selection / fallback | Evidence (source / static / executed / measured) | Unverified scope |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Coupled shard drafts | DeepSeek-V4.1 + DSpark | `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_SHARD=1`, coupled drafts on, one request, TP group | sharded keyed argmax in the query graph; else the fused coupled kernels (logged once) | CPU interpreter, 4 emulated ranks, ties across shards; measured on 8x V100 | GPU rounding not covered by the CPU test |
| Local keyed verification | same | `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_LOCAL=1`, all rows random, temperature only | shard verification; else the gathered path (reason logged once) | CPU interpreter, fallback matrix; measured on 8x V100 | same |
| Switches off | all | default | unchanged | CPU tests of the touched files, same results as #1370 | — |

## Acceleration and benchmark contract (required for performance changes)

- Default enabled or opt-in: opt-in; all four switches default off.
- Required CLI options and environment switches: #1370 PP2 x TP4 profile, `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_DRAFTS=1`, then `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_SHARD=1` and/or `VLLM_V41_COUPLED_LOCAL=1`.
- KV cache dtype used for the benchmark: the #1277 packed-KV default.
- Wheel SHA or source commit: measured on our build of the #1277 merge (`899e9ed33`) with the PP2 x TP4 port; this branch is the change on #1370 + #1375, rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`.
- PYTHONPATH, source overlays, or external native libraries used: none.
- User-entry route-hit, speed, and output-quality evidence: below.
- Existing kernel/backend registry and capability-rejection reasons: unchanged; each fallback logs its reason once.
- Per-engine configuration and deprecated-variable compatibility: no variable renamed or removed.
- New/changed environment metadata and generated reference check: four experimental variables registered with metadata; env, config-inventory and architecture references pass.
- Route snapshot command and intentional changed rows: none.
- SM70 registered variables / unregistered reads / model-parameter restrictions, before -> after: +4 registered, 0 unregistered reads.

## Test Result

**MEASURED, 2026-11-03,** 8x V100-SXM2-32GB, DeepSeek-V4.1 PP2 x TP4, one request, DSpark 5, paired arms over 11 prompts, ms per verify round:

| switch | T=1 change | prompts faster |
| --- | ---: | --- |
| `COUPLED_SHARD=1` | -0.26 / -0.20 ms (two runs) | 11 of 11, 9 of 11 |
| `COUPLED_LOCAL=1` | -0.12 to -0.24 ms | |

Outputs identical. With greedy requests (T=0) the coupled paths are inactive.

**Re-run for this PR, 2026-11-05,** CPU only (no visible GPU), on #1370 + #1375 rebased onto `main` `3c051b52e`:

- `TRITON_INTERPRET=1` pytest, the six files above: 108 passed.
- pytest `test_rejection_sampler.py`, `test_gpu_model_runner.py`, `test_dspark.py`, `test_rejection_sampler_utils.py`: 15 passed, 3 skipped, 110 failed, 17 errors on both this branch and #1370 alone, with identical failing names (no CUDA device visible). Nothing new fails.
- `generate_env_reference --check`, `config_inventory --check`, `check_env_metadata.py`, `check_env_registration.py`, `generate_architecture_reference --check`: all pass.
- ruff 0.14.0 `check` and `format --check` on the 14 changed Python files: pass.

Not re-run: any GPU test or serving; the table was not re-measured on this branch.

---
